description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Notification Under Section 2(3)(b) of the Statute No. 2 of 2011 regarding Powers to monitor administration in Local Government Authorities established in Uva Province
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the appointment of a retired judicial officer (Mr. H. M. R. Anura Kumara) by the Provincial Governor to investigate a local government authority (Badulla Municipal Council). The content centers on a judicial/legal investigation into administrative matters of a local council, which falls under judicial/law enforcement functions related to oversight and legal proceedings within government administration.
